list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades via Exophase; PSN progress counts via PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below rather than a trophy to chase directly. Work through the story first, then the side strands and activities, then the collectibles and the 100% checklist. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the list's progress counts.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official trophy list) · PSNProfiles (trophy list and counts)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from start to finish and the trophy pops at its end. It is the first story beat of the game, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Story chapters cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions in order and it arrives on its own. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Like every chapter trophy, it is unmissable: main-story progress alone earns it, so there is no side task to remember. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission and the trophy unlocks as the chapter wraps up. No preparation is needed — the chapter trophy follows naturally from finishing the story missions in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this trophy pops as the chapter closes, marking the end of the main story arc's chapters. It is unmissable, earned purely by completing the chapter's missions. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks at the credits. It is the story's natural endpoint, so it cannot be missed — finishing the last mission is all it asks. Save a manual save before the finale if you want to keep free-roaming afterwards without replaying it. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a mission-completion trophy, so it is unmissable — just play the mission through to its conclusion. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy unlocks at its end. Heist missions are long, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, then follow the mission objectives through to the getaway. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end and the trophy pops. Mission trophies are unmissable, so there is no special trick — finish the mission and move on. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners and the trophy unlocks when it finishes. As with the other mission trophies, it cannot be missed — completing the mission is the whole requirement. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops at its conclusion. It is unmissable, so play the mission normally and it will unlock on completion. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks at its end. Mission trophies are unmissable — the only requirement is finishing the mission itself. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen — every story mission, side strand, activity, collectible set and checklist item the game counts. This is the long grind that the platinum depends on, so use this tracker's checklist and the roadmap's Stage 4 to tick off the remaining categories one by one. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the trophy list and its counts.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official trophy list) · PSNProfiles (trophy list and counts)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like all count toward the running total. The counter climbs passively while you drive around doing other things, so treat it as a background goal and check the in-game stats now and then. If you want to grind it, chain jumps off ramps and highway crests in a fast car. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 250-stunt count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — the count PSNProfiles lists is 9 types, covering the pastimes spread across Leonida such as racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games and bowling. Work through the list one by one and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 9-type count.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official trophy list) · PSNProfiles (9 activity types)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range, learn each challenge's target layout, and favour accuracy over speed — a calm, steady aim beats spraying. Bronze and silver medals do not count, so replay any challenge that falls short until it turns gold. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 42-challenge count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one of them, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn the course on a practice run, then race cleanly through the gates. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 14-location count.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same race do not count, so spread your wins across the race list. Pick a fast, grippy car, learn each route's corners, and work through the easiest races first. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 20-race count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges reward patience: watch the line tension, reel in steadily when the fish runs, and ease off before the line snaps. Challenge Cal when you meet him at a fishing spot and out-fish him to take the trophy. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end at any arcade in Leonida. Pick the cabinet whose game you find easiest, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to its ending screen. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops at its end. Contact strands unlock as the story progresses, so keep returning to Andy's marker whenever it appears until his last mission is done. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand through to its final mission and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Like the other contact strands, it is unmissable — follow his missions whenever they appear until the last one is complete. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with its final mission and the trophy pops. Keep answering Billy's calls and markers as the story unfolds until his strand closes. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger markers appear around the map as you explore — start each strand, follow it to its last mission, and repeat until eight strands are done. Keep an eye on the map while free-roaming so no stranger goes unnoticed. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 8-strand count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand through to its final mission and the trophy unlocks at its end. Contact strands are unmissable — keep taking Randy's missions whenever they appear until the strand closes. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand with its final mission and the trophy pops. Follow his missions as they appear and the strand will close on its own at the last one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida. The spots sit in quiet, scenic places — beaches, hilltops and parks — so sweep the map region by region and meditate at each one you find, ticking them off in this tracker as you go. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 18-spot count.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt down the unique animal Bret asks for. Unique animals are one-off hunts, so bring a scoped rifle, track the animal patiently, and take a clean shot — spooking it can end the hunt. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, then complete it. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are tucked around Leonida — in shops, hideouts and out-of-the-way spots — so collect them as you explore and check which sets are still missing cards. Finishing three complete sets pops this silver trophy. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 3-set count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a long sweep, so fold it into your exploration: WAiNK It at every new spot you pass rather than saving it for a separate grind, and the count will climb steadily toward 100. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 100-location count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, so the total rises naturally across a full playthrough — check the challenges menu, pick off the easy ones first, and let the rest accumulate as you play. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 50-challenge count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Stay together while the heat is on — the trophy needs your partner present for the escape, so do not split up mid-chase. A fast car, back roads and a hiding spot out of the search area will shake the tail. Missable note: it needs the partner present, so attempt it while partnered, not solo. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the streak breaks if the heat drops to zero between robberies, so keep the cops on you the whole time. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep your partner at your side. Missable note: the chain must stay unbroken, so plan the route before the first robbery. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each new one you find and it joins the count. Variety is the shortcut: try cars, bikes, boats and anything else with an engine, and sweep car parks, docks and highways for models you have not driven yet. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 100-vehicle count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a shootout with plenty of cover works well — then trigger Combat Focus and chain your shots quickly, since the window is short. If you fall one short, reload a save and try again. Missable note: it must be five in one use, so pick a busy fight rather than a quiet one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — that is, depart by aircraft without going through a normal flight. Grab a plane or helicopter on the airfield and take off on your own terms. Missable note: it is a one-off moment at the airport, so do it the first time you get airside access. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — get into the thick of it with them, whether that means driving one or dealing with one in a firefight. Head for the military base or a high wanted level where Rhinos roll out, and engage until the trophy pops. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Case the store first, move quietly, avoid the cameras and guards, and get in and out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again rather than fighting through it. Missable note: detection voids the attempt, so a stealthy approach is the whole trick. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each hit: scout the bank, bring a fast getaway car, and know your escape route before you go in. Five successful vault jobs with clean getaways earns this silver. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 5-vault count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — spot one, stop it, crack it open and grab the cash, then shake the wanted level that follows. A sticky bomb or a hard ram can force it to stop. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area, so sweep the state systematically — cities, swamps, beaches and back roads — and watch for the last few grey patches on the map. A helicopter makes the final sweep much faster. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 52-area count.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots around the map — hit one per gang and the trophy pops once all nine are covered. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so none is repeated by mistake. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 9-gang count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find the bar spot with a view over the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. It is a small, scenic moment rather than a mission — walk the beachfront until the prompt appears, order the drink, and take in the view. Missable note: it is tied to that one spot, so do it while you are in the area. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass in a showroom car and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, get behind the wheel inside, and floor it through the front window. Missable note: it needs a showroom break-out, so attempt it deliberately rather than hoping it happens by accident. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through. It is a small activity moment — step up to the lane, aim, and let the ball roll with a full follow-through. Missable note: it is tied to that specific alley, so do it while you are there. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about the partnership hitting the big time — a moment of mass appeal with your partner. It follows from story and partner moments, so keep playing the partner content as it appears and the trophy will pop when the big moment lands. Missable note: it is tied to a specific partner moment, so do not rush past partner scenes. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500 for this trophy. Choices appear throughout the game in missions, conversations and side content, so keep choosing whenever the game offers a decision and the count will climb. It is a long tally, so treat it as a background goal across the whole playthrough. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 500-choice count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something — the trophy's name says it plainly: second time's the charm. Fail an attempt at a challenge or event once, then succeed at the very next try, and it pops. If it does not trigger, look for repeatable events where a failed first run is easy to arrange. Missable note: it needs a failure followed by a success, so do not reload a save to erase the failure. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a weird, out-of-place event somewhere in Leonida. Strange encounters hide in odd corners of the map, often at night or in remote spots, so explore the unusual places and keep your eyes open. Missable note: it is a one-off sighting, so investigate anything odd the moment you notice it. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. A slow drive past a pedestrian with a bat ready does it; pick a quiet street so you can line the hit up cleanly. Missable note: it needs a melee hit from a vehicle, so use a melee weapon, not a gun. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the guide itself is written from that description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the laundered total climbs toward $250,000. Keep robbing and keep laundering and the trophy arrives. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the $250,000 figure.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything the shops sell. The total is cumulative across every shop, so buy gear as you need it and the number climbs on its own; late in the game, big purchases like vehicles close the gap fast. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the $100,000 figure.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale as you progress — buy each one when it appears, keep enough cash in reserve for the expensive ones, and the trophy pops with the eighth purchase. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 8-garage count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one in the app, and repeat until ten are on the books — variety helps, since the app wants different vehicles rather than the same one ten times. Sources: Exophase for the official list; PSNProfiles for the 10-vehicle count.
